notes.title: 1.04 Release
notes.notes:
[h1]New Features[/h1]

[list]
[*] The Woman now talks
[*] Visual improvements
[*] Two new Events
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Improved compression: File size reduced from 900 MB to 300 MB
[*] Main Menu now supports Ultrawide Resolution
[*] Less Bathrobe clipping
[/list]
